exercises.title: PE question 3: Bike and MyBike implements the given IBike
concepts: f1 count / f2 sort / f3 remove
exercises.problemHtml:
The most common question 3 shape. Bike (place, price), IBike and Main are given. Write MyBike implements IBike:

  • int f1(List<Bike> t) — how many bikes have a place whose second character is a digit (e.g. "A1B").
  • void f2(List<Bike> t) — sort by place ascending; equal places by price descending.
  • void f3(List<Bike> t) — remove the first bike with the maximum price (only one, even on a tie).

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 4 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Do not change Bike.java, IBike.java or Main.java.

exercises.title: Bug hunt: equals without hashCode
concepts: HashSet and HashMap rely on hashCode
exercises.problemHtml:
Member overrides equals (two members are equal when their ids are equal, ignoring case) but not hashCode. The test class shows what goes wrong: a HashSet keeps "duplicates", a HashMap cannot find a member created again from the same id, List.contains works (it only uses equals). Fix Member:

  • equals: same class, ids equal ignoring case; null and other types → false;
  • hashCode consistent with equals (hash the upper-cased id).

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 2 case(s) (1 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • @Override on both methods.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Member ghi đè equals (hai thành viên bằng nhau khi mã bằng nhau, không phân biệt hoa thường) nhưng không ghi đè hashCode. Lớp kiểm cho thấy hậu quả: HashSet giữ "bản trùng", HashMap không tìm được thành viên tạo lại từ cùng mã, còn List.contains vẫn đúng (nó chỉ dùng equals). Sửa Member: equals cùng lớp, mã bằng nhau không phân biệt hoa thường, null hay kiểu khác → false; hashCode nhất quán với equals (băm mã đã viết HOA).

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Hash-based collections use hashCode to choose a bucket and equals inside the bucket. Overriding equals without a matching hashCode breaks HashSet and HashMap silently, while List (equals only) keeps working — which is why the bug survives simple tests.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Collection dựa trên băm dùng hashCode để chọn ô và equals bên trong ô. Ghi đè equals mà không có hashCode tương ứng làm HashSet và HashMap hỏng âm thầm, trong khi List (chỉ dùng equals) vẫn chạy — đó là lý do lỗi sống sót qua các phép thử đơn giản.

mistakesJson.loi: hashCode() returning id.hashCode() — "M001" and "m001" are equal but hash differently.|||hashCode() trả id.hashCode() — "M001" và "m001" bằng nhau nhưng băm khác nhau.
equals(Member other) instead of equals(Object o) — an overload; HashSet still calls Object.equals.|||equals(Member other) thay vì equals(Object o) — đó là nạp chồng; HashSet vẫn gọi Object.equals.
Casting without checking the type — equals("M1") throws ClassCastException.|||Ép kiểu mà không kiểm loại — equals("M1") ném ClassCastException.

exercises.title: A 10-mark Q1: the shop’s stock in a Map
exercises.problemHtml:
Commands change and report a stock kept in a Map<String, Integer> (product code → quantity). Codes are case-insensitive (store upper-case).

  • IN code qty — add (qty 1..1000), new codes allowed → IN SP01 +20 = 20.
  • OUT code qty — remove; unknown code → ERROR unknown product SP09; not enough → ERROR only 5 of SP01 left; when the quantity reaches 0 the product is removed from the map → OUT SP01 -5 = 0 (removed).
  • REPORT — every product A–Z: SP01: 15, then total items: 42; empty → stock is empty.
  • LOW n — codes with quantity < n, A–Z, comma-separated, or none.
  • A bad line (wrong command, missing parts, qty not a number or out of range) → ERROR bad command: <line>.

solutionCodeJson.name: cham.mjs

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: A TreeMap keyed by the upper-cased code is the whole data model: getOrDefault for adding, null checks for removing, remove() when a quantity reaches 0, and sorted iteration for free in the reports. Parsing errors are turned into one message, so no line can crash the program.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Một TreeMap với khoá là mã viết hoa là toàn bộ mô hình dữ liệu: getOrDefault khi thêm, kiểm null khi bớt, remove() khi số lượng về 0, và duyệt đã sắp miễn phí cho báo cáo. Lỗi parse được gom về một câu báo, nên không dòng nào làm sập chương trình.

mistakesJson.loi: Leaving a product with quantity 0 in the map — REPORT then lists "SP02: 0".|||Để sản phẩm số lượng 0 trong map — REPORT khi đó in "SP02: 0".
int have = stock.get(code) for an unknown code — NullPointerException while unboxing.|||int have = stock.get(code) với mã lạ — NullPointerException khi mở hộp.
